articles.summary: Appointment Adds Experienced Capital Markets Leader to DTI's Board HOUSTON, Jan. 27, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Drilling Tools International Corp. (NASDAQ: DTI) ("DTI" or the "Company") today announced that Ira H. Green, Jr. has been appointed to the Company's Board of Directors, effective immediately.
articles.title: Drilling Tools International Corp. Announces Appointment of Ira H. Green, Jr. to its Board of Directors
